_comment: TWO-STATE capability evidence - the machine-readable side of the contract.
A capability may register in an engine spec ONLY when it has full-pipeline delivery
evidence (a real job: intake -> builder -> executor gates -> review -> delivered
registered (engine, input_kind, output_kind) has a supported entry here.
This file replaced the prose evidence cards of the former docs/ENGINE_VALIDATION.md;
the human guidance lives in docs/engines/overview.md. Job ids refer to runs recorded in the
local corpus/trace layer at the noted dates. Add an entry ONLY for a genuinely
delivered capability; deleting a capability from a spec should delete its entry.
